name: dotnet-project

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - develop

jobs:
  build_the_binary:
    name: Build and Run NopCommerce
    runs-on: self-hosted

    steps:
      # 1️⃣ Checkout repository
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # 2️⃣ Install .NET 9 SDK (user-level, no sudo)
      - name: Set up .NET SDK (local install)
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.dotnet"
          curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o dotnet-install.sh
          bash dotnet-install.sh --channel 9.0 --install-dir "$HOME/.dotnet"
          echo "DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$HOME/.dotnet" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          echo "$HOME/.dotnet/tools" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      # 3️⃣ Verify installation
      - name: Verify .NET installation
        run: |
          which dotnet
          dotnet --info

      # 4️⃣ Restore dependencies
      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore src/Presentation/Nop.Web/Nop.Web.csproj

      # 5️⃣ Build project
      - name: Build project
        run: dotnet build src/Presentation/Nop.Web/Nop.Web.csproj -c Release --no-restore

      # 6️⃣ Publish project
      - name: Publish project
        run: dotnet publish src/Presentation/Nop.Web/Nop.Web.csproj -c Release -o demo

      # 7️⃣ Copy Themes folder (if present)
      - name: Copy Themes folder
        run: |
          mkdir -p demo/Themes
          if [ -d "src/Presentation/Nop.Web/Themes" ]; then
            cp -r src/Presentation/Nop.Web/Themes/* demo/Themes/
          fi

      # 8️⃣ Run the application
      - name: Run the application
        working-directory: demo
        run: dotnet Nop.Web.dll
